title: Hallucination Mitigation using Agentic AI Natural Language-Based Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2501.13946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hallucinations remain a significant challenge for Generative AI, undermining trust in AI systems and their reliability. This study investigates how orchestrating multiple specialized AI agents can mitigate hallucinations, with a focus on systems that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) for agent interaction. We design a pipeline that feeds 310 prompts, purposefully crafted to induce hallucinations, into a front-end agent; its outputs are reviewed and refined by second- and third-level agents that detect unverified claims, add explicit disclaimers and clarify speculative content. We introduce four novel Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - Factual Claim Density, Factual Grounding References, Fictional Disclaimer Frequency and Explicit Contextualization Score - aggregated into a Total Hallucination Score (THS) and assessed by a dedicated fourth-level evaluator agent. translated_title: 使用智能体AI自然语言框架缓解幻觉
translated_abstract: 幻觉仍然是生成式人工智能面临的重大挑战，它削弱了人们对AI系统及其可靠性的信任。本研究探讨了如何通过编排多个专业化的AI智能体来缓解幻觉问题，重点关注采用自然语言处理（NLP）进行智能体间交互的系统。我们设计了一条流水线：将310条特意设计以诱发幻觉的提示输入前端智能体，其输出由二级和三级智能体进行审查与完善，这些智能体负责检测未经验证的说法、添加明确的免责声明并澄清推测性内容。我们提出了四个新颖的关键绩效指标（KPI）——事实声明密度、事实依据引用数、虚构免责声明频率和显式情境化评分——并将它们汇总为总幻觉评分（THS），由专门的第四级评估智能体进行评估。智能体间的上下文信息由开放楼层协议（OFP）承载。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于自然语言交互的多智能体协作框架，通过四级智能体流水线检测、修正并量化AI幻觉，并创新性地提出四个关键绩效指标及总幻觉评分（THS）来系统评估幻觉缓解效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a multi-agent NLP-based framework with a four-level agent pipeline to detect, correct, and quantify AI hallucinations, introducing four novel KPIs aggregated into a Total Hallucination Score (THS) for systematic evaluation.
